memories.content: The executive team consists of the CEO, CFO, and head of product. They will meet at the quarterly review to decide on the balcony-panel pilot. The head of product champions the pilot; the CFO wants engineers reallocated to utility-scale; the CEO is publicly neutral. The team is aware of the 400-unit sales against a 1,000-unit target, strong reviews, and thin margins.

Veldt Solar's balcony-panel pilot sold 400 units against a 1,000-unit target, with strong reviews but thin margins. The quarterly review is scheduled for 2026-10-05. The executive team (CEO, CFO, head of product) will decide whether to shelve or greenlight the pilot. If a decision is made, it will be communicated to the pilot team. The hard cutoff for communication is 2026-10-16T18:00:00+02:00.
